bank.name: Seerah: Life in Makkah & Madinah
bank.subject: Islamic Studies
bank.description: The life of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) — the Makkan and Madinan periods.

questions.prompt: In which year was the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) born?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) was born in 570 CE, the Year of the Elephant, in Makkah.

questions.prompt: Who was the father of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH)?
questions.explanation: His father was Abdullah, who died before the Prophet's (PBUH) birth.

questions.prompt: Who was the foster mother of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH)?
questions.explanation: Halima Sa'diyyah of the Banu Sa'd tribe nursed and raised him in the desert in his early years.

questions.prompt: Who raised the Prophet (PBUH) after the death of his grandfather Abdul-Muttalib?
questions.explanation: After Abdul-Muttalib's death, the Prophet (PBUH) was raised by his uncle Abu Talib.

questions.prompt: The Prophet (PBUH) worked as a trader for which noblewoman before marriage?
questions.explanation: He managed trade caravans for Khadijah, a wealthy widow, before marrying her.

questions.prompt: At what age did the Prophet (PBUH) receive the first revelation?
questions.explanation: He received the first revelation in the Cave of Hira at age 40, in 610 CE.

questions.prompt: Who was the first free man to accept Islam?
questions.explanation: Abu Bakr was the first free adult man to accept Islam.

questions.prompt: Who was the first child to accept Islam?
questions.explanation: Ali, the Prophet's (PBUH) cousin, was the first child to embrace Islam.

questions.prompt: Who was the first slave to accept Islam?
questions.explanation: Bilal ibn Rabah, later the first mu'adhdhin, was the first slave to accept Islam.

questions.prompt: The Prophet (PBUH) hid in which cave during the Hijrah?
questions.explanation: He and Abu Bakr hid in the Cave of Thawr for three days on the way to Madinah.

questions.prompt: Who accompanied the Prophet (PBUH) on the Hijrah?
questions.explanation: Abu Bakr was his companion on the Hijrah; Ali stayed behind to return trusts.

questions.prompt: What was Madinah called before the Prophet's (PBUH) arrival?
questions.explanation: Madinah was formerly known as Yathrib before being renamed Madinat-un-Nabi.

questions.prompt: Who built Masjid-e-Nabawi in Madinah?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) and the companions built the first Masjid-e-Nabawi after the Hijrah.

questions.prompt: The document establishing rights and duties between Muslims and the Jews of Madinah is called?
questions.explanation: The Charter of Madinah created a multi-community state and mutual protection in Madinah.

questions.prompt: How many pledges (bay'ah) of Aqabah were made before the Hijrah?
questions.explanation: The First Aqabah (12 BH/621 CE) and Second Aqabah (13 BH/622 CE) paved the way for the Hijrah.

questions.prompt: The 'Year of Sorrow' (Aam-ul-Huzn) was marked by the deaths of which two people?
questions.explanation: In 619 CE, Khadijah and Abu Talib both died, a year of great sorrow for the Prophet (PBUH).

questions.prompt: The boycott of Banu Hashim by the Quraysh lasted approximately how long?
questions.explanation: The social and economic boycott of Banu Hashim lasted about three years (617-619 CE).

questions.prompt: The first migration of Muslims to escape persecution was to which place?
questions.explanation: In 615 CE, Muslims migrated to Abyssinia, whose Christian king (Negus) sheltered them.

questions.prompt: How many Muslims went in the first migration to Abyssinia?
questions.explanation: The first group numbered about 15 Muslims, led by Uthman ibn Affan.

questions.prompt: The Prophet (PBUH) passed away in which year and at what age?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) passed away on 12 Rabi-ul-Awwal 11 AH (8 June 632 CE) at about 63 years of age.

questions.prompt: In which year of Prophethood did the Migration to Abyssinia (Hijrah to Habshah) take place?
questions.explanation: The first migration to Abyssinia took place in the 5th year of Prophethood due to persecution in Makkah.

questions.prompt: Who was the Negus (King) of Abyssinia who gave asylum to the Muslim migrants?
questions.explanation: Najashi, the just Christian king of Abyssinia, protected the Muslim migrants and later accepted Islam.

questions.prompt: What was the 'Year of Sorrow' (Aam-ul-Huzn)?
options: The year the Prophet (PBUH) lost Khadijah (RA) and Abu Talib
questions.explanation: In the 10th year of Prophethood, the Prophet (PBUH) lost his wife Khadijah (RA) and uncle Abu Talib.

questions.prompt: Which city did the Prophet (PBUH) visit on the Journey of Ta'if?
questions.explanation: After the Year of Sorrow, the Prophet (PBUH) went to Ta'if to invite its people, but was rejected and stoned.

questions.prompt: How many nights did the Prophet (PBUH) hide in the Cave of Thawr during the Hijrah?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) and Abu Bakr (RA) hid in the Cave of Thawr for three nights before proceeding to Madinah.

questions.prompt: Who accompanied the Prophet (PBUH) during the Hijrah?
questions.explanation: Abu Bakr Siddiq (RA) accompanied the Prophet (PBUH) on the journey of migration to Madinah.

questions.prompt: Which Jewish tribe broke its treaty and was expelled from Madinah after the Battle of the Trench?
questions.explanation: Banu Qurayzah betrayed the treaty during the Battle of the Trench and were dealt with afterward.

questions.prompt: Which mosque in Madinah has the green dome marking the Prophet's (PBUH) burial place?
questions.explanation: Masjid Nabawi in Madinah houses the Rawdah and the Prophet's (PBUH) grave beneath the Green Dome.

questions.prompt: How many years did the Prophet (PBUH) live in Madinah after the Hijrah?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) spent the last 10 years of his life in Madinah, from 1 AH to 11 AH.

questions.prompt: What was the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah?
options: A 10-year peace pact with the Quraysh
A military alliance with the Ansar
questions.explanation: The Treaty of Hudaybiyyah (6 AH) was a 10-year truce between the Muslims and the Quraysh of Makkah.

questions.prompt: Which Surah was revealed in connection with the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Fath (The Victory) was revealed after the treaty, calling it a clear victory.

questions.prompt: Who was the companion chosen to give the Adhan at the conquest of Makkah?
questions.explanation: Bilal bin Rabah (RA), the first mu'adhdhin, gave the Adhan atop the Kaaba at the conquest of Makkah.

questions.prompt: Which was the first verse revealed?
options: Read (Iqra) in the name of your Lord
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Alaq's first verses began with Iqra.

questions.prompt: How long did the Makkan phase of prophethood last?
questions.explanation: The Makkan period lasted 13 years.

questions.prompt: How long did the Madinan phase of prophethood last?
questions.explanation: The Madinan period lasted 10 years.

questions.prompt: The first Muslims who migrated to Abyssinia were led by:
questions.explanation: Ja'far led the migrants to Abyssinia.

questions.prompt: The 'Year of Grief' saw the deaths of:
questions.explanation: Both died in 619 CE.

questions.prompt: The 'Night Journey' (Isra) took the Prophet (PBUH) to:
questions.explanation: Isra was the journey to Masjid al-Aqsa.

questions.prompt: The first Pledge of Aqabah involved how many people?
questions.explanation: Twelve men took the first pledge.

questions.prompt: The second Pledge of Aqabah involved:
questions.explanation: Seventy-three men and two women pledged at the second Aqabah.

questions.prompt: Who accompanied the Prophet (PBUH) in the cave of Thawr during Hijrah?
questions.explanation: Abu Bakr was with him in the cave.

questions.prompt: The first 'Jumu'ah' prayer in Islam was offered at:
options: Banu Salim valley on the way to Madinah
questions.explanation: The first Jumu'ah was held near Madinah.

questions.prompt: The 'Constitution of Madinah' was signed between:
options: Muslims, Jews and other Madinan tribes
questions.explanation: It established rights for all communities.

questions.prompt: The 'Mu'akhah' (brotherhood) paired which companions?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) paired migrants with hosts.

questions.prompt: Which tribe broke the Treaty of Hudaibiya?
questions.explanation: Bani Bakr's attack led to the Conquest of Makkah.

questions.prompt: The Conquest of Makkah occurred in:
questions.explanation: Makkah was conquered in Ramadan 8 AH.

questions.prompt: At the Conquest of Makkah, the Prophet (PBUH) granted:
questions.explanation: He declared 'go, you are free'.

questions.prompt: The Prophet (PBUH) passed away in which year?
questions.explanation: He passed away in 11 AH, aged 63.

questions.prompt: Who was the first wet nurse of the Prophet (PBUH) before Halima?
questions.explanation: Thuwaybah, a freed slave of Abu Lahab, nursed the Prophet (PBUH) briefly before Halima.

questions.prompt: In his youth, the Prophet (PBUH) worked as a shepherd for whom?
options: His family and the Quraysh (for hire)
questions.explanation: Like many prophets, Muhammad (PBUH) tended sheep in his youth.

questions.prompt: Which monk recognized the Prophet (PBUH) as a future prophet during a trading journey?
questions.explanation: The Christian monk Bahira saw the seal of prophethood and recognized the young Muhammad (PBUH).

questions.prompt: Which pact for justice did the Prophet (PBUH) participate in during his youth?
questions.explanation: Hilf al-Fudul was a pact to protect the oppressed, which the Prophet (PBUH) approved.

questions.prompt: What titles did the Quraysh give the Prophet (PBUH) before prophethood?
questions.explanation: The Quraysh called him Al-Amin (the trustworthy) and Al-Sadiq (the truthful).

questions.prompt: At what age did the Prophet (PBUH) marry Khadija (RA)?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) married Khadija (RA) at the age of twenty-five.

questions.prompt: How old was Khadija (RA) when she married the Prophet (PBUH)?
questions.explanation: Khadija (RA) was about forty years old at the time of her marriage.

questions.prompt: Who were the sons of the Prophet (PBUH) from Khadija (RA) and Maria (RA)?
questions.explanation: The Prophet's (PBUH) sons were Qasim, Abdullah (Tayyib) and Ibrahim.

questions.prompt: Who were the daughters of the Prophet (PBUH)?
options: Zainab, Ruqayyah, Umm Kulthum and Fatima
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) had four daughters: Zainab, Ruqayyah, Umm Kulthum and Fatima.

questions.prompt: Which house served as a meeting place for early Muslims in Makkah?
questions.explanation: Dar al-Arqam, the house of Arqam ibn Abi al-Arqam, was a refuge for early Muslims.

questions.prompt: Who tortured Bilal (RA) to make him renounce Islam?
questions.explanation: Bilal's (RA) master Umayyah bin Khalaf tortured him in the Makkan sun.

questions.prompt: The Isra and Mi'raj took place approximately how long before the Hijrah?
questions.explanation: The Night Journey is generally dated to about 621 CE, roughly a year before the Hijrah.

questions.prompt: During the Mi'raj, the five daily prayers were made obligatory by whom?
questions.explanation: The five daily prayers were gifted by Allah during the Mi'raj and delivered by the Prophet (PBUH).

questions.prompt: In the Isra and Mi'raj, which prophet did Muhammad (PBUH) meet in the seventh heaven?
questions.explanation: In the seventh heaven the Prophet (PBUH) met Ibrahim (AS), leaning against the Bait al-Ma'mur.

questions.prompt: The 'Seal of Prophethood' (Khatam an-Nubuwwa) was located where on the Prophet (PBUH)?
questions.explanation: The seal of prophethood was a mark between the Prophet's (PBUH) shoulder blades.

questions.prompt: Whose conversion is said to have emboldened the Muslims to pray openly at the Kaaba?
questions.explanation: The conversion of Umar (RA) greatly strengthened the early Muslims in Makkah.

questions.prompt: Who slept in the Prophet's (PBUH) bed on the night of the Hijrah?
questions.explanation: Ali (RA) slept in the Prophet's bed to deceive the Quraysh on the night of the Hijrah.

questions.prompt: What protected the mouth of the Cave of Thawr during the Hijrah?
options: A spider's web and a dove's nest
questions.explanation: Allah sent a spider and a dove so the Quraysh saw an undisturbed cave entrance.

questions.prompt: Who pursued the Prophet (PBUH) and Abu Bakr (RA) during the Hijrah?
questions.explanation: Suraqa bin Malik chased them but his horse stumbled; he later turned back in peace.

questions.prompt: Who served as the guide for the Prophet (PBUH) on the Hijrah?
questions.explanation: The skilled guide Abdullah bin Urayqit led the Prophet (PBUH) to Madinah.

questions.prompt: In whose house did the Prophet (PBUH) stay when he first arrived in Madinah?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) lodged at the house of Abu Ayyub al-Ansari until the mosque was ready.

questions.prompt: Which mosque commemorates the change of the Qibla from Jerusalem to the Kaaba?
questions.explanation: Masjid al-Qiblatain in Madinah is where the direction of prayer was changed.

questions.prompt: What is the 'Bai'at-e-Rizwan'?
options: The pledge of allegiance under the tree at Hudaybiyyah
questions.explanation: At Hudaybiyyah the companions pledged loyalty to the Prophet (PBUH) under a tree — Bai'at-e-Rizwan.

questions.prompt: Which ruler received a letter from the Prophet (PBUH) inviting him to Islam?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) sent letters inviting Heraclius, Khosrow, the Negus, Muqawqis and others.

questions.prompt: In which year did the Prophet (PBUH) perform the Farewell Pilgrimage?
questions.explanation: The Farewell Pilgrimage (Hajjat-ul-Wida) took place in 10 AH.

questions.prompt: Where did the Prophet (PBUH) deliver his Farewell Sermon?
questions.explanation: The Farewell Sermon was delivered at Arafat on the 9th of Dhul-Hijjah.

questions.prompt: In whose room did the Prophet (PBUH) pass away?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) fell ill and passed away in the room of Aisha (RA).

questions.prompt: Where is the Prophet (PBUH) buried?
options: In his room beside the Prophet's Mosque in Madinah
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) was buried in his room, now within Masjid Nabawi.

questions.prompt: Which uncle of the Prophet (PBUH) is condemned in Surah Al-Masad?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Masad (Lahab) condemns Abu Lahab and his wife for their hostility.

questions.prompt: Which companion migrated to Abyssinia with his wife Ruqayyah, the Prophet's daughter?
questions.explanation: Uthman (RA) and Ruqayyah (RA) were among the migrants to Abyssinia.

questions.prompt: After the death of his mother, at what age did the Prophet (PBUH) come under his grandfather's care?
questions.explanation: Amina (RA) died at Abwa when the Prophet (PBUH) was about six; Abdul-Muttalib then cared for him.

questions.prompt: After Ta'if, the Prophet (PBUH) recited the Quran to a group of whom at Nakhlah?
questions.explanation: On the way back from Ta'if, a group of jinn listened to the Quran at Nakhlah.

questions.prompt: Who are the 'Ansar'?
options: The Muslims of Madinah who helped the migrants
questions.explanation: The Ansar were the Madinan Muslims who sheltered and supported the Muhajirun.

questions.prompt: Who are the 'Muhajirun'?
options: The Muslims who migrated from Makkah to Madinah
questions.explanation: The Muhajirun were the Makkan Muslims who emigrated for the sake of Allah.

questions.prompt: Who was the first to give the Adhan in Madinah?
questions.explanation: Bilal (RA) was the first mu'adhdhin of the Prophet's Mosque.

questions.prompt: Where was the successor to the Prophet (PBUH) chosen after his death?
questions.explanation: The Ansar gathered at Saqifah Bani Sa'idah, where Abu Bakr (RA) was chosen Caliph.

questions.prompt: Which relative recognized the Prophet's (PBUH) first revelation as true prophethood?
questions.explanation: Waraqa bin Nawfal, Khadija's cousin, affirmed the revelation as prophethood.

questions.prompt: Who comforted the Prophet (PBUH) after the first revelation and took him to Waraqa?
questions.explanation: Khadijah (RA) reassured the Prophet (PBUH) and accompanied him to her cousin Waraqa.

questions.prompt: What is the pause in revelation after the first verses called?
questions.explanation: The temporary pause in revelation is known as the Fatrah.

questions.prompt: After the Fatrah, which surah was revealed next?
questions.explanation: The second revelation commanded the Prophet (PBUH) to arise and warn — Surah Al-Muddaththir.

questions.prompt: From which hill did the Prophet (PBUH) make his first public call to the Quraysh?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) ascended Mount Safa and called the Quraysh to testify to Allah's oneness.

questions.prompt: What was the kunya (patronymic) of the Prophet (PBUH)?
questions.explanation: The Prophet's (PBUH) kunya was Abu al-Qasim, after his son Qasim.

questions.prompt: The name 'Muhammad' means?
questions.explanation: Muhammad comes from the root 'hamd' — the one who is praised.

questions.prompt: In which year did the Prophet (PBUH) leave Makkah for Madinah?
questions.explanation: The Hijrah took place in 622 CE, the epoch year of the Islamic calendar.

questions.prompt: Who was the first woman the Prophet (PBUH) married after Khadija's death?
questions.explanation: Sauda bint Zam'a was the first wife the Prophet (PBUH) married after Khadija (RA).

questions.prompt: How many idols were around the Kaaba at the time of the Conquest of Makkah?
questions.explanation: Tradition says some 360 idols stood around the Kaaba, all destroyed after the conquest.

questions.prompt: What was the name of the Prophet's (PBUH) camel during the Hijrah?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) rode the she-camel Qaswa on the Hijrah; Al-Buraq was the Mi'raj mount.

questions.prompt: Where the Prophet's (PBUH) camel stopped in Madinah, he built what?
questions.explanation: The camel knelt at the site where Masjid Nabawi was later built.

questions.prompt: The boycott against Banu Hashim was declared by whom?
questions.explanation: The Quraysh imposed a social and economic boycott on Banu Hashim in the 7th year of prophethood.

questions.prompt: The boycott document was hung where?
questions.explanation: The Quraysh hung the boycott decree inside the Kaaba; Allah later had it eaten by termites.

questions.prompt: After the Conquest of Makkah, the Prophet (PBUH) declared what?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) granted a general amnesty, saying 'Go, for you are free.'

questions.prompt: Which tribe's attack helped the Quraysh break the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah?
questions.explanation: Banu Bakr, allies of Quraysh, attacked Banu Khuza'ah, allies of the Muslims, breaking the treaty.
